description: This file defines the SupervisorModel class in the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It models supervisor data related to reports-to relationships within the HRM system, implementing serialization and normalization features, and constructs itself from ReportTo entity instances.

classes.name: SupervisorModel
classes.description: A model representing supervisor details in the HRM system, designed for serialization and normalization processes, built from a ReportTo entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SupervisorModel with a ReportTo entity, setting entity data, filters, and attribute names for serialization.
